_doc: What every gadget shares (Phase 8; game/shared/src/gadgets/DESIGN.md §1-§4). Taking a gadget out of its slot takes `equipS`; a throw winds up for `throw.windupS`, then leaves from `throw.fromM` (right, down and ahead of the eye) at the profile's speed, `upDeg` over the view: Fire throws overhand, ADS lobs underhand, the Nitro Cell has the heavy throw (research/gadgets.md: Y3S4's throw curves, numbers unknown). In flight it is a ball of `radiusM` under gravity (data/movement.json); a bounce keeps `restitution` of the speed into the surface and loses `friction` of the speed along it, and below `restMps` on something flat it comes to rest; after `maxS` anything still flying stops where it is. The owner takes back a gadget that can be picked up by holding Interact for `pickUpS` within `pickUpReachM`. Every number here is ours (placeholders). Metres, seconds, degrees.
